summary:
No new work claimed: roughly three minutes of the run's budget remain, every question in the record is answered or explicitly bounded, and no open necessary gap or promising local lead is left that could be investigated in the time available. The path returned is the last accepted draft, unchanged, so this is a no_change signal rather than a duplicate revision.

Rather than repeat the full inventory, the essentials for the offline reviewer: three receipt-backed defects (leadership-transfer order accepted with no term/identity/membership binding; `GetConfiguration().Index()` constant zero defeating the documented `prevIndex` guard; repeated identical automatic snapshots on a snapshot-recovered idle node, with control), one conditional finding (deprecated voter-only peer encoding on a below-protocol-2 leader after a rollback-style restart), and a body of sourced behaviours and negative results covering snapshot recency, lease-bounded `VerifyLeader` completion, reload validation, 25-round configuration propagation, pipeline cursor ownership, the heartbeat fast path, log-store/barrier/progress/shutdown/observation/batching/RPC-version contracts, and existing-state detection — each with its conditions and stated limits, and with the two genuinely unresolved boundaries (the un-reproduced captured-test failure, and the fast path being unexecutable without a network namespace) recorded as such. No further action will be taken on my side; the run may expire with this record.
